scientific_question: Does life-history state release latent mobility, and does landscape opportunity modulate the magnitude/timing of that release?
priority_design: within-individual or within-system yellow-to-silver stage contrast

eligibility.taxon: Anguilla spp. preferred for primary test
required: identified or defensible onset of silver/outmigration state for at least a subset
spatial detections/positions sufficient to estimate movement scale
landscape connectivity or hydrological opportunity measurable without using the movement outcome
preferred: same individuals observed before and after transition
multiple water bodies or strong within-system hydrological contrast
reject_if: stage is inferred solely from the movement outcome being tested
tracking starts only after directed migration has already begun
movement metric cannot be harmonised across individuals
landscape covariates are selected after seeing movement outcomes

primary_estimand: within-individual change in movement around independently defined migratory-state onset
stronger_model: state x landscape opportunity plus body size, season and tracking design

interpretation.state_effect_only: mobility is strongly state dependent but landscape gating is not established
interpretation.no_state_effect: core hypothesis not supported in this system

no_rescue: do not change state-onset definition or landscape covariates after inspecting the primary contrast
